Mr. Clark recorded the height and shoe size of the players on the basketball team he coaches. The information he collected is summarized in the scatter plot above. 

Given that none of the points overlap, which of the following statements are true?

- Only one player has a shoe size of $9\frac{1}{2}.$
- Only one player is $195\,\text{cm}$ tall.
- There are exactly two players taller than $185\,\text{cm}.$
